scope: Current Coupon implementation and Browser/Memo reference; status is delivery scope, not a claim that a suite was executed.

coverage.note: Coupon only: actual Token-2022 payouts and record-date rights; fresh local acceptance required for each code revision.
Redemption/Voting instructions and end-to-end acceptance absent; preparatory fields are not these use cases.
Partial redemption, Merkle claims and external adapters explicitly outside current implementation.
Instrument, issuance, registry and controlled frozen-account transfers.
Financial terms and mint stored; separate issuer identity absent; MVP combines issuer/operator authority.
Outstanding supply exists; full redeemed supply/status journey awaits Redemption.
Exact current registered balances are independent of snapshot rights.
Clock barrier, complete snapshot, immutable ordered hash and post-record transfer.
Checked integer coupon formula, per-holder rounding and aggregate totals.
Principal/final-coupon/voting-power preparation exists; no actual redemption or voting execution.
Explicit approval, fully funded vault, once-only atomic settlement and finalization.
Maturity, holder-signed burn/payment, persistent redemption lock and supply reconciliation absent.
Proposal, holder-signed unique votes, window, quorum and tally absent.
Coupon PDA/events, transaction links, final receipt and public audit; RPC provenance/history limits remain.
No typed actions, versioned receipts, persistent redemption lock, period deduplication or vote receipts.
Coupon transition table and Scheduled-only cancellation enforced; multi-kind engine absent.
Indexer, Merkle distributor, role separation, metadata history, partial redemption and adapters absent.
Verified for implemented Coupon scope; no promise about missing scenarios or exhaustive attacks.
Coupon state/hash/signature evidence verified through trusted RPC; archive completeness, cryptographic RPC provenance and historical destination ownership not independently proven by UI.
Prior human Devnet golden remains historical evidence; this audit executes local validator, not a new real Phantom/Devnet replay.
Tracked source checked for common embedded key patterns; operator key stays in wallet; disposable holder keys in browser are demo-only. No exhaustive secret-history audit.
Coupon cross-action substitution and transitions covered; no action-kind dispatch to verify yet.
IDL parity and existing Coupon layout unchanged; new-layout migration/historical decoder acceptance remains open.
Single scheduled/pending Coupon barrier exists; coupon period deduplication and redemption/vote conflicts absent.
Provenance, proof availability, measured scaling and incorporated-code inventory future scope.
Current Coupon acceptance; failed runtime CPI evidence, duplicates, unauthorized operations and partial resume.
No redemption/voting acceptance or new versioned-layout compatibility proof; field assertions do not count.
Real second Coupon action cannot reuse rights/vault/receipt; wrong-kind dispatch remains unimplemented.
Coupon capture/calculation/settlement resume after reload, complete snapshot and rejection of post-begin cancellation.
Acceptance gates for explicitly unimplemented Post-MVP work.
